sentences.en: Life is not an exact science, it is an art.
sentences.zh: 生活不是一门精确的科学，而是一种艺术。

sentences.en: Where can I go to buy art books and catalogues?
sentences.zh: 我去哪里能买到艺术书籍和目录？

sentences.en: The lake is made not by nature but by art.
sentences.zh: 湖是人工修建的而不是自然形成的。
